```{r}
raw <- read_json("data/wildfires.geojson")

length(raw$features)
```

```{r}
first_fire <- raw$features[[1]]

names(first_fire)

first_fire$geometry$type

first_fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]]
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
fires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties) |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state,
         geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
         fire_year = as.integer(fire_year))

```


```{r}
fires |>
  filter(str_detect(incident, "August"))

fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10) |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, state)
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  mutate(
    lon = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(coords) mean(map_dbl(coords[[1]], 1))),
    lat = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(coords) mean(map_dbl(coords[[1]], 2)))
  )
```


```{r}
top10 <- big_fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10)

fire_map <- leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.DarkMatter)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(top10))) {
  ring <- top10$geometry_coordinates[[i]][[1]]
  fire_map <- fire_map |>
    addPolygons(
      lng = map_dbl(ring, 1),
      lat = map_dbl(ring, 2),
      color = "#ff8c1a",
      weight = 1.5,
      fillColor = "#ff6a00",
      fillOpacity = 0.45,
      popup = paste0("<b>", top10$incident[i], "</b><br>",
                     top10$fire_year[i], "<br>",
                     scales::label_comma()(round(top10$gis_acres[i])), " acres")
    )
}

fire_map |>
  fitBounds(min(top10$lon) - 1, min(top10$lat) - 1,
            max(top10$lon) + 1, max(top10$lat) + 1)
```
